Arma 2 is a 2009 tactical shooter simulation video game
It is the second main entry in the Arma series
like its predecessor Arma: Armed Assault
Arma 2 maintains a significant modding community
well-known as the origin of DayZ, a survival game conversion that was later developed into its own standalone game in 2018
An expansion pack, Arma 2: Operation Arrowhead, was released in 2010.
The game's sequel, Arma 3, was released in 2013.
